# Orca DSH Launcher

Version v1.6.0 | Platform Windows | License MIT

A Cordis plugin + desktop component for DeepSeek Harness (DSH) that provides update checking, server start/stop, system tray, a graphical console, and one-click installation.

Project homepage: https://github.com/Lheyang/orca-dsh-launcher

## Features

- Update check: On DSH startup, compares the local git commit against the official master branch. If an update exists, it logs a message and shows a notification. Query only - never auto-updates.
- /orca command set: 14 sub-commands covering status, start/stop, restart, logs, port, config, diagnostics, tray, and console.
- System tray: WinForms NotifyIcon - left-click opens the UI, right-click menu starts/stops the server and checks for updates.
- Graphical console: WPF management window (Overview / Server / Install / Logs / Settings / About) with dark/light themes; opens even when DSH is not running.
- One-click install: The console Install page or the standalone wizard orca-setup (single-file EXE distribution) supports two paths: full version (git clone + pnpm install + pnpm run build + pnpm dsh web), or official Web version (npx @deepseek-ai/dsh web, Node.js only).
- Not-installed guidance: When DSH is not installed, the status card and start/open buttons clearly prompt and guide the user to the Install page - no silent failures.

## Installation

Quick start with DSH (official Web version, no plugin needed):
npx @deepseek-ai/dsh web

Install this plugin (DSH already installed):
powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts\install.ps1
Then restart DSH to activate.

The install script copies the runtime files to ~/.dsh/profiles/web/node_modules/orca-dsh-launcher/, appends an insert registration to cordis.patch.yml (UTF-8 without BOM), automatically migrates the legacy dsh-update-checker plugin, and creates a startup tray shortcut and a desktop icon (skip with -SkipStartupShortcut / -SkipDesktopShortcut).

Uninstall: scripts\uninstall.ps1 (auto-backup; -KillTray also closes the tray; -KeepShortcut keeps the startup shortcut).

One-click DSH install on a fresh machine:
- Option 1: Download orca-setup.exe from GitHub Releases and double-click it (embedded plugin package, single-file distribution).
- Option 2: After installing this plugin, open the console Install page and choose "Install Full Version" or "Launch Official Web Version".

## Usage

/orca slash commands (handler returns { kind: 'success' | 'error', text }; config is re-read on every execution):

- /orca status (状态): server / port / update status
- /orca check (检查): check for updates now
- /orca start (启动): start the DSH server
- /orca stop (关闭): stop the DSH server (never kills non-DSH processes)
- /orca restart (重启): one-click restart
- /orca open (打开): open the UI (auto-starts the server first if not running)
- /orca log (日志): recent run logs
- /orca port (端口): port ownership details
- /orca config (配置): current effective configuration
- /orca health / diagnose (诊断): environment health check
- /orca console (控制台): open the graphical console
- /orca tray (托盘) / /orca tray-stop (关闭托盘): start / stop the tray
- /orca help (帮助): help

Tray: left-click opens the UI; right-click menu includes "Open Console...", "Check for Updates", "Start/Stop Server", and "Log Location...".

## Configuration

Config file: ~/.dsh/orca-dsh-launcher.json (pure ASCII JSON, shared by tray/console/plugin; auto-generated with defaults on first run).

Fields and defaults:
- dshDir: local DSH source directory (default D:\deepseek harness)
- port: Web UI port (default 3080)
- repo: official repository (default deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)
- branch: branch to check (default master)
- checkTimeoutMs: network query timeout (default 8000)
- trayAutoStart: auto-start tray when DSH starts (default true)
- theme: console theme (default dark)

User data (do not delete): orca-dsh-launcher.json (config), orca-stats.json (usage stats, atomic writes), orca-dsh-server.log (server log, auto-rotated above 2MB), update-check-state.json (update check results).

## Architecture

- plugin.js: Cordis plugin - update check, /orca commands, launches tray and console
- orca/orca-common.ps1: shared logic library - config, start/stop, port detection, stats, update check (shared by tray and console)
- orca/orca-install.ps1: install core logic - environment and network detection, git clone, pnpm install+build, npx web launch, plugin install (shared by wizard and console)
- orca/dsh-tray.ps1: system tray (WinForms NotifyIcon)
- orca/dsh-console.ps1: graphical console (WPF navigation UI)
- orca/start-*.vbs/ps1: hidden-window launchers and startup entries
- orca-setup.ps1: standalone install wizard (packaged as orca-setup.exe)
- scripts/install.ps1: install the plugin into DSH (copy + register + startup + desktop icon)
- scripts/uninstall.ps1: uninstall
- scripts/test-all.ps1: full test suite (7 items)
- scripts/build-exe.ps1: build the launcher EXE (ps2exe + payload injection)
- test/: smoke, inject, real-cordis, and payload pipeline tests

Key technical points:
- Cordis plugin form: object plugin { name, inject: ['commands'], apply } - inject must be declared explicitly, otherwise "cannot get property commands without inject".
- Encoding conventions: .ps1 files must be UTF-8 with BOM (PowerShell 5.1 parses BOM-less files as GBK and mangles Chinese); JSON/YAML config files must be read/written with explicit UTF-8 without BOM via .NET methods.
- Port ownership detection: Get-NetTCPConnection / netstat -ano to get the PID, then Get-CimInstance Win32_Process for the command line, regex pnpm|dsh|deepseek|harness|tsx to decide whether it is DSH, avoiding killing unrelated Node processes.
- Payload injection: build-exe.ps1 packages the plugin files into a zip then Base64 and replaces the __PLUGIN_PAYLOAD_B64__ placeholder in orca-install.ps1; at runtime it unpacks to a temp directory (single-file EXE distribution, offline plugin install).
- Process management: installs/starts run in the background via Start-Process cmd /c ... >> log 2>&1; the UI polls HasExited and the log tail with a DispatcherTimer (800ms) to avoid blocking the interface.

## Development

Environment: Windows, PowerShell 5.1, Node.js.

Full test suite (7 items: syntax, plugin load, console self-check, tray self-check, real Cordis load, wizard self-check, payload pipeline):
powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts\test-all.ps1

Build the EXE (output dist\orca-setup.exe, upload to GitHub Releases):
powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts\build-exe.ps1

Project version is the code in this repository; the runtime version lives at ~/.dsh/profiles/web/node_modules/orca-dsh-launcher/ (what DSH actually loads; install.ps1 syncs and backs up automatically).

Versioning: semantic versioning, package.json is the single source of truth (tray/console read it dynamically).
